tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condtions as per tender documetns

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder must submit a notarized Document which is not later than 3 months old prior to the Tender Date, that the Company/or any subsidiary of the Company/ Partners/ Stake holding Members of the Bidding Company have not been barred from participation of Tenders/Dealings/Business with any Government OR Private Organizations any time
The Bidder and /Or the OEM represented by the Dealer must have valid and latest ISO Certification

The Bidder should demonstrate the capability of executing supplies matching the size and type of the subject tender by submitting copies of recent past Purchase Orders / Work Orders of value at least 3.5 crore in a single contract in any one of the last 3 years received in the Bidders name, preferably from a Government Institution / Organization of similar kind / Listed / Reputed / Commercial Organizations. Receipt of the Purchase Order by the Bidder must be clearly documented.

The Bidders average annual financial turnover, inclusive of all components and taxes, shall not be less than Rs. 30.00 Crores (Rupees Thirty Crores only in the last 03 preceding financial years, viz 2023-24 to 2025-26. (50% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises during previous 2 financial years 2023-24, 2024-25). In case the Audited Turnover Records of 2025-26 is not available as on the date of Tender submission, Records of 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25 may be considered and decision entirely rests with the Tender Committee
The Equipment offered for supply must be of the most recent series models meeting the requirements, incorporating the latest improvements in design

Only authorized dealer / agency of original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or OEM having minimum 5 years of experience in operation should Bid this Tender. Proof of Purchase Orders / Installation certificates should be attached

The supplier must either be a principal company (Original Equipment Manufacturer) or an Authorized Dealer quoting on behalf of the OEM. They must have manufacturing / after sales service centers operative in Karnataka for at least 3 years and the same to be supported by authenticated Documentary proof

The Bidder/Supplier must have a reasonable customer base for supply of the above Equipment. The bidder must submit copies of Purchase Orders and related invoices/DCs/Completion Certificates to support the claim

The bidder must be in the business of manufacturing of same or similar type of Machinery / Equipment / System / Instruments, who has manufactured, supplied, Installed & commissioned the offered Machine / Equipment / System / Instruments, and shall meet the following criteria for offered Machine / Equipment / Tools / Instruments

The Tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment(s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in ANNEXURE A.1 up to at least worth 80 % of the Bid quantity required in Annexure A.1, in the last 3 financial years. In case of MSME-Karnataka the same must be 40% in the last 3 years.

The Bidder shall enclose copy / copies of the contract(s) / Purchase Orders for Central Government / State Government Institutions / Agencies / Departments / PSUs executed during last 3 financial years (included in Performance statement) prior to date of Bid publication for supply of the same or similar type & capacity of Equipment/Machines as offered

Only Bidder having a minimum 5 years of experience in operation in the same/Similar Business should Bid this Tender. Proof of Purchase Orders / Installation / Satisfactory Completion Certificates should be attached

If the Manufacturer is bidding through their Authorized Dealer/Representative, the manufacturer should furnishes Authorization in the prescribed format assuring full Guarantee and Warranty obligations support for Supply & Services as per Technical, Statutory and Administrative requirement

Bidder should have Service / Spare Support network in Karnataka operating for more than 3 years & must submit the statement as per Performa for Service / Spare Support Networks substantiated/Supported with Government Authenticated Documents

Manufacture/Supplier should have installations of same or better model to reputed institutions worldwide or in India. A Satisfactory Performance certificate / installation report to be provided for eligibility. Bidder should submit complete contact details along with supplied Purchase Orders

The Bidder must be in the business of Dealing/supplying same or similar type of Machine / Equipment / System / Instruments, from a highly reputed and popular Manufacturer / Manufacturers who has manufactured same / similar Equipment / System / Instruments
